titleEn: Inter-Ministerial Prakas No. 306 on the Establishment of the Revenue Budget at the Ministry of Environment

articles.en:
- A revenue budget is hereby established at the Ministry of Environment in order to collect the various non-tax revenues in accordance with the applicable regulations. The list of revenue types for which the 2023 revenue budget is established is as follows:
1- Sub-account 73023, proceeds from the establishment of enterprises, amount 904,000,000 riels
2- Sub-account 73028, proceeds from administrative authorisation, administrative forms and other administrative management, amount 450,800,000 riels
3- Sub-account 73048, proceeds from other services, amount 8,500,000 riels
4- Sub-account 73087, proceeds from product quality inspection and compliance with standards, amount 3,303,400,000 riels
5- Sub-account 74012, fines and pecuniary penalties, amount 420,000,000 riels
6- Sub-account 75081, proceeds from environmental protection contributions, amount 2,305,000,000 riels; total amount 7,391,700,000 riels

- The maximum amount authorised to be retained in the petty cash account shall not exceed 2,000,000 riels
(two million riels).
[Illegible in source]
- Any provisions contrary to this inter-ministerial prakas shall be considered null and void.

- The Director of the Cabinet, the Secretary-General, the Government Delegate in charge as Director-General of the General Department of the National Treasury, the Government Delegate in charge as Director-General of the General Department of State Property and Non-Tax Revenue, the Inspector-General, and the heads of all relevant inter-institutional bodies under the authority of the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the Ministry of Environment shall be responsible for implementing this inter-ministerial prakas from the date of signature onwards; [date illegible]; done at Phnom Penh, [day illegible] [month illegible] 2023.
